transformations: File-keyed SHA256 fingerprint assignments become row lists containing file and sha256. Original hash values are preserved.
Simulator/device identifiers, host-local command lines, private source references and nonportable host paths are omitted. No private credential/env files are opened.
Selected known repository path prefixes become portable logical source paths. No screenshot pixels, AX values, operation outcomes or chronological history are invented.

installation: Prototype only; no target copy. A later reviewed install can include these projections plus exact public_asset_dependencies. Original metadata/context JSON with host-local identifiers is provenance input, not a public-copy dependency.
limitations: No narrative candidate, accepted capture subset, freeze, canonical readiness, timing or media qualification.
Raw diagnostic states, failed attempts and prewritten claims remain source history; copied metadata is not independent pixel approval.
Source fingerprints describe recorded code/artifacts, not bundled binaries or a full application backup. Related source profiles/support patches remain separate dependencies.
All original raw files and dated audits/checkpoints remain unchanged.
